requirements.description: Replace the legacy on-prem order-management system with a cloud-based platform.
requirements.sourceText: They want a modern, cloud-based platform for store associates and call-centre agents.

requirements.description: Web app for associates to create and track orders quickly.
requirements.sourceText: Store associates need a fast web app to create and track orders.

requirements.description: AI assistant answers 'where is my order' using order + shipment data.
requirements.sourceText: an AI assistant that helps agents answer "where is my order" questions

requirements.description: AI drafts customer email replies for agent approval before sending.
requirements.sourceText: drafts customer email replies for agent approval

requirements.description: Returns processing workflow (scope unconfirmed for phase 1).
requirements.sourceText: They are unsure whether returns processing is in scope for phase 1.

requirements.description: Near-real-time order sync with SAP ERP.
requirements.sourceText: Orders must sync with the existing SAP ERP ... in near real time.
and the Salesforce CRM in near real time.

requirements.description: Store order and shipment data with EU residency.
requirements.sourceText: Data must stay in the EU.

requirements.description: Scale to Black Friday peak of ~500,000 orders/day without degradation.
requirements.sourceText: handle Black Friday peaks (up to 500,000 orders/day) without degradation.

requirements.description: Low-latency order creation (<1s) for associate productivity.
requirements.sourceText: Store associates need a fast web app (performance implied).

requirements.description: GDPR compliance and comprehensive audit logging.
requirements.sourceText: GDPR compliance and audit logging are mandatory.

requirements.description: SSO with corporate Microsoft Entra ID; human review of customer-facing AI output.
requirements.sourceText: support SSO with the corporate Entra ID ... reviewed by an agent.

assumptions.text: Payment processing remains in the existing system and is out of scope.
SAP and Salesforce expose usable APIs for near-real-time sync.
Peak concurrency is ~3,000 simultaneous users during Black Friday.

openQuestions.text: Is returns processing in scope for phase 1?
